reviews.name: Sharon,from Elgin, SC
reviews.comment: I appreciate this app so much, it makes writing ministry letters so much easier. The drafts are thoughtful and I always edit them to sound more like me — which is exactly the point.

name: Rizza P., Lugoff, SC.
comment: I am really thankful for the PioneerPen app. It helps me organize my thoughts and topics for letter writing so much easier. I also use it when sending messages to my non-Witness friends and relatives. I just edit the message a little so it sounds more like me. It’s such a wonderful, helpful, and easy to use app. 5 ⭐️ for me!
